newsitem.title: JAPAN: FORECAST-Japan August leading index seen below 50.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Japan August leading index seen below 50.

text.p: Japan's closely watched diffusion index of leading economic indicators for August is likely to have been at 33.3 percent, falling below the so-called "boom or bust" 50 percent line for the first time in five months, economists said on Friday.

The index of coincident indicators for August is also seen below the 50 percent line for the first time in three months, standing at 30.0 percent. "However, the data does not mean that the economy has started contracting. I expect both indicators to rise above the 50 mark in September," said Yoshihiro Ishimaru, an economist at Daiwa Bank Research Institute.
The indicators will be announced at 2 p.m. (0500 GMT) on Tuesday.
Economists said a delay in inventory adjustments by corporations, especially in the semiconductor industry, affected the September data.
Production in September is likely to show improvement, they said.

The following five research institutions all expect the leading index to be at 33.3 percent, and the coincident index at 30.0 percent: Daiwa Bank Research, Yamaichi Research, Nikko Research, DKB Research Institute and Sakura Securities.
